    Home/Growth hormone

    Growth hormone peptides, compared with the approved medicines.

    Peptide Chooser editorial team. Checked 30 Oct 2026.

    Every claim links to its source.

    Growth hormone itself (somatropin) is FDA approved, mainly for children and adults with growth hormone deficiency. Tesamorelin (Egrifta) is approved only to reduce belly fat in adults with HIV and lipodystrophy.

    Compare the options

    Is it legal today?

    For raising growth hormone: what is approved and for whom, and what the sold peptides are.

    • CJC-1295 · vials sold to raise growth hormoneNot approvedresearch use only

      A peptide meant to make the body release growth hormone, in research-use vials. Not approved.

      A long-acting copy of the hormone that tells the body to release growth hormone. In two trials in healthy adults it raised growth hormone and IGF-I; the trials did not measure muscle or strength. 1

      Not approved for any use.

      Research-use shops, with our checks.

      No listings yet
    • Ipamorelin · vials sold to raise growth hormoneNot approvedresearch use only

      A peptide meant to make the body release growth hormone, in research-use vials. Not approved.

      Acts on a different receptor than CJC-1295, with the same aim. Its one larger trial in people, 117 patients after bowel surgery, found it did no better than a placebo. The FDA lists safety concerns for it. 2, 3, 4

      Not approved for any use.

      Research-use shops, with our checks.

      No listings yet
    • IGF-1 LR3 · vials sold as IGF-1Not approvedresearch use only

      Sold as a form of IGF-1, in research-use vials. Drugs@FDA lists no product with it.

      Sold for growth by research-use shops. The approved IGF-1 medicine is a different product, mecasermin (Increlex). 5

      Not approved for any use.

      Research-use shops.

      No listings yet
    • Sermorelin · pharmacy-made growth-hormone shotNo FDA-approved product on the marketon prescription

      A pharmacy-mixed shot on prescription that makes the body release growth hormone. No approved product.

      A growth-hormone-releasing shot from compounding pharmacies; the approved brand was taken off the market years ago.

      No FDA-approved product on the market.

      Prescription through clinics.

      No listings yet
    • Growth hormone (somatropin) · approved growth hormone shotFDA approvedon prescription

      Lab-made human growth hormone, a shot on prescription. FDA approved mainly for growth hormone deficiency.

      Approved for children who do not grow because of growth hormone deficiency or some other conditions, and for adults with growth hormone deficiency. Not approved for healthy adults who want more muscle or energy. 6

      FDA approved, mainly for growth hormone deficiency.

      Prescription.

      On prescription; no clinic prices yet
    • Tesamorelin (Egrifta) · daily shot for belly fat in HIVFDA approvedon prescription

      A daily shot on prescription, approved only to reduce belly fat in people with HIV, not for muscle.

      A daily shot approved only to reduce belly fat in people with HIV. Sold off-label by clinics for "growth hormone". 7

      FDA approved for HIV-related belly fat only.

      Prescription.

      On prescription; no clinic prices yet

    Is it legal today?

    FDA status checked 30 Oct 2026

    Sermorelin's approved product left the market years ago; online clinics prescribe pharmacy-made versions. CJC-1295, ipamorelin and IGF-1 LR3 are research-use products with no approved version; we show their prices and checks and do not link to the shops.

    FDA status of the peptides on this page, each with its source.

    PeptideStatusWhat that means
    SermorelinNot approvedno FDA-approved product is on the market; the approved brand was taken off the market years ago 8
    Tesamorelin (Egrifta)FDA approvedexcess belly fat in HIV, prescription; not approved for muscle or aging 9

    Approved means the FDA approved a product containing it for a stated use. Not approved means no approved product exists; buying it for yourself is not a crime in the US, but nobody has checked what is in the vial. All substances

    Questions about growth hormone peptides

    What are the best growth hormone peptides?

    Growth hormone itself (somatropin) is FDA approved, mainly for children and adults with growth hormone deficiency. The options on this page: CJC-1295, vials sold to raise growth hormone; Ipamorelin, vials sold to raise growth hormone; IGF-1 LR3, vials sold as IGF-1; Sermorelin, pharmacy-made growth-hormone shot; Growth hormone (somatropin), approved growth hormone shot; Tesamorelin (Egrifta), daily shot for belly fat in HIV.

    Are growth hormone peptides FDA approved?

    Not approved: CJC-1295, Ipamorelin and IGF-1 LR3. No FDA-approved product on the market: Sermorelin. FDA approved: Growth hormone (somatropin) and Tesamorelin (Egrifta). Each status has its source under "Is it legal today?".

    Do I need a prescription for growth hormone peptides?

    Research use only: CJC-1295, Ipamorelin and IGF-1 LR3. On prescription: Sermorelin, Growth hormone (somatropin) and Tesamorelin (Egrifta).
